{{Top|leg}}
'''Giamel''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Giamel commented on the entry for the [[SnapShoot DT3]], relating a story about a group of youths on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who uncovered a cache of the ancient weapons. They began challenging anyone they came across to quick-draw duels where the weapons gave them an edge.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Giamel also believed that the [[Flame Rifle]] was a fearsome weapon, mainly because the thought of being set on fire terrified them more than being shot by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Giamel commented on the entry for the [[DL-22 blaster pistol]], noting that the DL-22 wasn't too different from the [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]], although the better focusing crystal allowed the DL-22to inflict more damage.<ref name="GFT" />
